biography_sections.title: Original evidence and remaining gaps
biography_sections.markdown:
### NRS Kilwaghter estate targets — 21 September 2026

For the gap between the 1653 Larne occurrence and later Kilwaughter households, the NRS catalogue identifies **Open, On site** primary files: [GD154/514](https://catalogue.nrscotland.gov.uk/nrsonlinecatalogue/details.aspx?reference=GD154%2f514&st=1&tc=y&tl=n&tn=n&tp=n&k=&ko=a&r=GD154%2f5&ro=s&df=&dt=&di=y) (tenant goods/livestock, c.1653), [GD154/515](https://catalogue.nrscotland.gov.uk/nrsonlinecatalogue/details.aspx?reference=GD154%2f515&st=1&tc=y&tl=n&tn=n&tp=n&k=&ko=a&r=GD154%2f5&ro=s&df=&dt=&di=y) (rental, c.1653), [GD154/525](https://catalogue.nrscotland.gov.uk/nrsonlinecatalogue/details.aspx?reference=GD154%2f525&st=1&tc=y&tl=n&tn=n&tp=n&k=&ko=a&r=GD154%2f5&ro=s&df=&dt=&di=y) (rentals, c.1690; two items), [GD154/530](https://catalogue.nrscotland.gov.uk/nrsonlinecatalogue/details.aspx?reference=GD154%2f530&st=1&tc=y&tl=n&tn=n&tp=n&k=&ko=a&r=GD154%2f5&ro=s&df=&dt=&di=y) (rent-roll/accounts, November 1692; three items), and [GD154/532](https://catalogue.nrscotland.gov.uk/nrsonlinecatalogue/details.aspx?reference=GD154%2f532&st=1&tc=y&tl=n&tn=n&tp=n&k=&ko=a&r=GD154%2f5&ro=s&df=&dt=&di=y) (rent-roll/accounts, 1693–1708; eight items).

Their catalogue text names no Glasgow and exposes no images. Search `Kilwaghter`, `Kilwaughter`, `Kilwaugheter` and Glasgow spelling variants in the originals. Even a matching tenant would be an occurrence, not proof that the 1653 Robert was father or ancestor of John, James, the later Robert, or any other Kilwaughter bearer.

biography_sections.title: The early Larne bridge remains unproved
biography_sections.markdown: The manuscript-checked 1738 and 1741 deeds concern the later Robert-1143 household, not Robert Glaskow of Larne in 1653. A 1772 Wm Glasgow witness is also unassigned. The inspected 1736 memorial 63221 and 1757 memorial 159181 confirm a later William–Hugh Larne joint-lessor association, but neither record supplies kinship or a bridge to Robert-3970 or the early Kilwaughter householders. The direct tests remain NRS GD154/514–515, /525, /530 and /532, PRONI T828/15 and MIC1B/6; no catalogue entry supplies descent proof.
